problems.description: The operator reports that some components or modules failed to deploy or are unhealthy. Each failing condition below is the operator's own message, followed by its cause as far as the tool can tell. Conditions with severity Info (for example components set to Removed) are not listed.
evidence: DataScienceCluster default-dsc: Ready=False (Error): Some modules are not ready: trainer

TrainerReady=False (Error): dependency not met: JobSet Operator is not installed. Please install the JobSet Operator via OLM (OperatorHub) before deploying Trainer. → cause: Job Set Operator is installed now, but the trainer module operator has not retried (see "The trainer module operator has not retried yet")
problems.fix: Fix the causes with the problems listed under Related: "The trainer module operator has not retried yet".

problems.title: The trainer module operator has not retried yet
problems.description: The module still reports a state that is no longer true. Module operators retry a failed reconcile with an exponential back-off that reaches about 16m40s and do not watch the operators they depend on, so the condition can stay for many minutes. A restart makes the operator reconcile at once.
evidence: DataScienceCluster default-dsc: TrainerReady=False (Error): dependency not met: JobSet Operator is not installed. Please install the JobSet Operator via OLM (OperatorHub) before deploying Trainer. It still reports JobSet Operator as not installed, but it is installed: Job Set Operator (CSV openshift-jobset-operator/jobset-operator.v1.0.1 Succeeded 1h0m ago; JobSetOperator/cluster exists)

Trainer default-trainer: Ready=False (Error): dependency not met: JobSet Operator is not installed. Please install the JobSet Operator via OLM (OperatorHub) before deploying Trainer. It still reports JobSet Operator as not installed, but it is installed: Job Set Operator (CSV openshift-jobset-operator/jobset-operator.v1.0.1 Succeeded 1h0m ago; JobSetOperator/cluster exists)

Operator Deployment redhat-ods-applications/trainer-operator-controller-manager (known operator of module trainer): 1 of 1 pods available, strategy RollingUpdate with maxSurge 25% and maxUnavailable 25% for 1 replica (up to 0 unavailable)
problems.fix: Restart redhat-ods-applications/trainer-operator-controller-manager. Kubernetes starts a new pod and stops the old one once the new one is ready.
problems.confirmMessage:
This patches Deployment redhat-ods-applications/trainer-operator-controller-manager: it sets the pod-template annotation kubectl.kubernetes.io/restartedAt to the current time, which is what oc rollout restart does. Kubernetes starts a new pod and stops the old one once the new one is ready.

Right before patching, the tool checks again that the trainer module still reports the problem, that a pod is available, and that the Deployment is unchanged since that check (UID and resourceVersion).
